packages.title: Listening sheet: «Escribir» on the online path, no microphone while nothing listens, TalkBack silent while recording, two lines that say what's true
brief: The capture sheet (App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart) has two speech paths. On-device shows live words. Online uses the app's own recorder and transcribes after Listo; it covers Voz «En línea, al terminar», Android 11 and older (NativeSpeechBridge.kt:71 needs API 31), phones without an on-device recognizer or language (Catalan on the emulator), and a capability probe that times out (native_speech.dart, `usable` false). On the online path the recorder's first amplitude event (every 120 ms) turns the capture into a recording (:832-850, :1203-1210). Check every change on both paths. This package changes the listening states and their lines; P273 changes understanding and failing, and P274 what happens after saving, in the same file: keep to the states named here.

UX-2101 (S3, review A1): on the online path nobody can type once listening starts. `recorded` (:2116) and `showType: !_typing && !recorded && !typeFirst` (:2473) hide «Escribir» from the first amplitude event on. On the emulator `device/capture.listening.ca.light.{1.0,2.0}.png` shows «S’està escoltant · 00:07», «Fet» and «Cancel·la», and no «Escriu». A free account with dictations left can't reach the form, a Pro account can't type, and offline only «Reintentar» is left; the only typing way is the launcher's long-press «Escribir una tarea». Fix: on the online path, show «Escribir» (for a free account, the labelled button with the key `capture-fill-by-hand`, UX-911) in every state where the on-device path shows it: listening, paused and failed. A tap stops the recorder. If nothing above the silence level was heard, drop the empty recording, as `_dropUnheardAudio` and `_dropSilent` already do. Otherwise ask the existing keep question («¿Conservar lo que has dicho para más tarde?», Descartar / Conservar): Conservar leaves the recording in «Sin guardar», Descartar drops it, and dismissing the question leaves the sheet where it was, as Cancelar's question does. Then open typing (Pro) or the form (free) with an empty field. Never hand the recording to the form. No new copy. TalkBack users are unaffected: their listening waits for «Empezar a hablar», with «Escribir» beside it.

UX-2106 (S2, review A1): a grey microphone shows while nothing listens. The ring shows whenever the sheet isn't typing (:2460-2463), and `_ring` (:2490-2520) draws a grey mic unless listening. In 7 of the 18 rendered sheet states (`capture/sheet.{paused,mic-denied,mic-blocked,mic-blocked-online,error-unavailable,error-limit-recording,error-nothing-understood}`) and on the emulator (`device/permission-mic.denied.*`, `device/capture.listening-ended.*`), a 72 dp mic in its ring sits mid-sheet; it isn't a button, it differs from listening only by colour, and the control that acts sits under it. Fix: show the ring only while starting («Un momento…»), listening and understanding; remove it in every other state (idle with «Empezar a hablar», paused, the microphone permission states, errors). Put nothing in its place: those states get about 104 dp shorter, which gives the words and banners room at 2×.

UX-2107 (S2, review A1): TalkBack's speech goes into the open microphone. With TalkBack on, the sheet waits for «Empezar a hablar» so the screen reader's speech isn't recorded (UX-109), but `_listening()` (:982-987) announces «Escuchando» as the microphone opens (NativeSpeechBridge.kt:228 emits `listening` as soon as the app's AudioRecord starts, and the recorder path calls `_listening()` right after `recorder.start`), and `captureTimeLeft(10)` is announced at 50 s (:1000). The VOICE_RECOGNITION source isn't guaranteed echo cancellation, so those words can land at the start and the end of the dictation. Fix, only while `MediaQuery.accessibleNavigationOf(context)` is true: after «Empezar a hablar», announce «Escuchando» first, and open the microphone about 1 s later, showing the starting state («Un momento…») meanwhile; announce nothing while recording; at 50 s give a haptic pulse instead of announcing «Quedan 10 segundos» (the visible countdown stays, and the 60 s cap still acts as Listo). The sighted flow keeps today's announcements and timing.

UX-2111 (S1, review A1): the first-use privacy line names neither Google's AI nor where «Ajustes» is. `capturePrivacyLine` (app_en.arb:531, app_es.arb:308, app_ca.arb:287; shown at :2433-2445 the first time the microphone is used on this phone, through `RegionalPreferences.privacyShown`) reads «Tus palabras van por internet. Más en Ajustes.», while Voz and the privacy policy say the words go to Google's AI, and the Ajustes tab has no «Voz» row (it's Ajustes › Otros ajustes › Voz). New values: ES «Tus palabras van a la IA de Google. Más en Otros ajustes › Voz.», EN “Your words go to Google’s AI. More in Other settings › Voice.”, CA «Les paraules van a la IA de Google. Més a Altres opcions › Veu.» The screen names are `otherSettings` and `voiceSettings` in each catalog: keep them identical. New @capturePrivacyLine description: `One short line under the words in the capture sheet, shown only the first time the microphone is used on this phone: says the words go to Google’s AI and names where the full note is (Other settings › Voice, as otherSettings and voiceSettings read; keep them identical).` Modelled with Manrope at 2× on 360 dp: 3 lines each, inside the line's 3-line limit. P282 reuses this key in the reminder sheet after you and widens its description; don't touch the reminder sheet.

UX-2113 (S1, review A1): the online listening hint promises words it never shows. `captureListeningOnline` (app_en.arb:1734, app_es.arb:911, app_ca.arb:726; shown at :2168-2169) reads «Te escucho. Verás tus palabras al tocar Listo.», but after Listo the online path shows the result, and the words only behind «Ver lo que dije». New values: ES «Te escucho. Al tocar Listo verás lo que he entendido.», EN “I’m listening. Tap Done to see what I understood.”, CA «T’escolto. En tocar Fet veuràs el que he entès.» Update its @description to say what follows Done (the result; the words are behind «What I said»). Modelled at 2×: 2–3 lines.

packages.title: Command cards: a set's tasks are all in the sheet's own scroll, «¿Cuál…?» answers look like answers, change lines name their field, and cards that found nothing show the search icon
brief: UX-2201 (S3, review A2): set cards hide tasks their button will change or delete. In `BulkCommandCard` (App/lib/widgets/capture_command_cards.dart:2323-2347), below 1.5× text the rows sit in a scroll inside the card (`_scroll`, its `Scrollbar` and a `ConstrainedBox` of max(160 dp, 40% of the height)); in `commands/cards.bulk-today-overdue.es.light.1x` 4 of 6 rows show, AUDIT measures «Recoger a los niños del colegio» as a 286 × 6 dp sliver and «Clase de yoga» is off screen, while «Marcar 6 tareas como hechas» acts on all 6; at 1.3× a 4-task «Pasa todas las de ayer a mañana» likely hides one (inferred from code). On a deletion the hidden tasks are deleted unseen. Fix: subtract the inner scroll, so the rows always go in the sheet's own scroll, as the `large` path (1.5× and up) already does: remove `_scroll`, its Scrollbar and the ConstrainedBox. The confirming button stays pinned in the footer; a row cut by the footer is the cue that more follows, as on every other result. No new copy. Set deletions keep opening at their heading and ✕ (UX-1704, UX-1718, UX-1719): their tests must keep passing.

UX-2204 (S2, review A2): «¿Cuál quieres cambiar?» answers look like plain text. `_Choice` (:1199-1274), used for change, delete and complete (:1363-1376, :1759-1772, :1845-1858), draws the matches as bare text rows, 0 dp apart (AUDIT), outside any question box, while the main button reads «Revisa los datos de arriba», disabled (`commands/cards.change-which.es.light.2x`). Every other question on these cards puts its answers as outlined chips in a `QuestionBox`. Fix: show the matches as the question's answers inside its QuestionBox, the question as the box's line; each match an outlined, full-width choice (the `outline` colour, at least 48 dp tall, 8 dp apart). «Ver N más» stays. One tap still picks the task and enables the main button. No new copy.

UX-2209 (S1, review A2): change lines name the field only by its icon. `line` (:1382-1404) writes «before → after» with an icon; priority (:1584-1590) and the deadline (:1564-1583) both use `Icons.flag_outlined`, so «Media → Alta» and «mar, 27 de oct → Mañana ▾» don't say which field (`cards.change-details`, `cards.change-deadline-only`), while set cards write «Prioridad: Alta» (`commandBulkField`, `_bulkSets` :1963-2013). Where the new deadline is a chip (`cards.change-deadline-only`), a second string, for example `commandChangeLineFrom`: «{label}: {before} →» (the same in the three languages), followed by the chip: «Fecha límite: mar, 27 de oct →» [Mañana ▾]. The values stay the standalone names («Media», «Alta»). TalkBack keeps `commandChangeSemantics` («Prioridad: de Media a Alta»). The day, title and person lines keep only their icons.

UX-2210 (S1, review A2): cards that found nothing keep the pencil or the bin. A change that found nothing uses `edit_outlined` (:1359), a deletion that found nothing the teal bin (:1752-1755), and set cards with nothing to do, or view-only, keep the action's icon (:2142-2146): renders `cards.not-found`, `cards.bulk-none` and `cards.bulk-view-only`, against `cards.complete-not-found`, which already uses the search icon (UX-1705). packages.title: Ticks, moves and steps show at once; the server sync runs behind
brief: UX-2301 (S3, review B1), with UX-2402 (S3, review B2), merged: ticks and moves wait for the server to answer. In App/lib/providers/task_provider.dart, `setCompleted` (:198-222, the wait at :221), `rescheduleTask` (:123-134), `changeOccurrence` (:146-186), `setChecklistCompleted` (:246) and `restoreTask` (:268) end with `if (mounted) await loadTasks();` inside the serialized `_mutate` chain (:116-121). `loadTasks` → `_loadLoop` (:43-71) awaits `_repository.sync()`, which refreshes the lists, sends pending changes, pulls every task page (cloud_task_repository.dart:237-254) and syncs files, each request allowed 12 s (api_client.dart:628-637). So the haptic and «Tarea completada · Deshacer» (TaskInteractions.toggle, App/lib/widgets/task_interactions.dart:19-37), «Movida al …», a step's tick on the task page, and every next tick queued behind them, wait for the network; a tick made while a load runs joins it; a swiped row stays slid out until the sync ends (`confirmDismiss`, task_tile.dart:232-238). Saves and every Deshacer already end with `showLocal()` (:75-86; UX-601, UX-1707).

Fix: in those five methods, replace `if (mounted) await loadTasks();` with `if (mounted) await showLocal();`, so each shows the phone's list at once and the sync runs behind, as the saves and undos do. Do the same in `moveToList` (:110-117), the one other `_mutate` method that ends the same way (the organizer's addition: the same pattern, recurring problem #18). No UI or copy change. Keep `_mutate`'s order: each change is still written after the previous one, but none waits for the network. The values these methods return (`TaskScheduleChange`, the occurrence change) still come from the local write. A background sync failure is recorded as today (`syncError`), never thrown into the tap.
Not yours: the completion message's words (P269 adds WD34's line in task_interactions.dart, after you), the task page (P280), the reader's reminders (P271, which adds a method here after you).
acceptance: Calendar, ES 1× on 360×800, with a repository whose cloud sync never completes (App/test/support/hanging_sync.dart, or as App/test/capture_landing_test.dart:644 does): tapping a row's circle shows it checked and «Tarea completada · Deshacer» within two frames; ticking a second row straight after checks it at once too; Deshacer reopens the first at once.
With the same hanging sync: «Cambiar fecha» › Mañana on a row shows «Movida al …» as the sheet closes, and the row has left the day; a swipe right on a row springs back at once, checked.
A task's page with the same hanging sync: ticking a step checks it at once, and a second step ticked 300 ms later checks too.
With a sync that takes 5 s and then succeeds, the list afterwards matches the server's, and no change is lost or applied twice.
deviceChecks: Phone on throttled mobile data: open the app and tick three tasks within 2 s; each ticks and shows its message at once.

packages.title: Today lists its own tasks first, ticked rows stay where they were, and the day's last tick says «Todo listo. Respira.» (WD34)
brief: UX-2302 (S3, review B1): overdue tasks push today's own tasks off the screen. App/lib/screens/calendar_screen.dart:955-986 puts «Atrasadas · N», its rows and a divider before the day's own rows; :437-457 lists them oldest first, with no limit, on today only. At 1× on 360×800 without shared-project chips there are 306 dp between the counts and «Añadir tarea»; each overdue row takes about 97 dp with its gap, plus 30 dp of heading and 21 of divider, so two overdue tasks cut today's first task and three hide all of them; at 2× one is enough (`calendar/agenda.busy.es.light.{1x,2x}`). Overdue tasks pile up for exactly the person who forgets to tick. Fix: list the day's own rows first, then the divider and «Atrasadas · N» with its rows, then the phone's events line and «Sin fecha · N». The same heading, counts and dates; no new copy or control. brief: UX-2401 (S3, review B2): tapping a reminder lands on «Sin recordatorio». The emulator capture `device/notification.tap-landing.es.light.1.0.png` (2026-10-29, 30c8ce0) shows «Pagar la luz» at 9:50, which rang at 9:40 («Hoy a las 9:50 · en 10 min»); the task it opens reads «Sin recordatorio: ya ha pasado la hora del aviso» with the crossed-out bell. When the reminder was set and its time has come (the engine has its alert: the `reminder_state` row for it, App/lib/services/task_database.dart:432, and it isn't blocked), the chip (:538-541, :564) and the form's row (:727-740, :791) say so, with the normal bell and the same tap: ES «Recordatorio enviado: hoy, 09:40», EN “Reminder sent: today, 09:40”, CA «Recordatori enviat: avui, 09:40». The time is `context.clockTime`; the day word is the plan lines' («hoy, 16:50»; another day as the plan lines write it). Suggested keys: `reminderSent` «Recordatorio enviado: {when}» / “Reminder sent: {when}” / «Recordatori enviat: {when}», `reminderSnoozed` «Recordatorio pospuesto: {when}» / “Reminder snoozed: {when}” / «Recordatori ajornat: {when}», `reminderPlanLast` «último: {when}» / “last: {when}” / «últim: {when}», each with an @description saying where it shows and what {when} is. packages.title: D9: a reader chooses their own reminders; a reader's reminders never offer «Completar»; nothing a reader does becomes a copy
brief: The owner, 2026-10-31 (DECISIONS.md, D9 (b)): a «lector» (viewer) can choose their own reminders on the tasks that ring for them; nothing else a reader sends changes. The server half is committed (bc80025; Backend/core/task_views.py:51-73; Backend/docs/REMINDER_PLANS.md:39, :89): a reader's PUT whose fields other than the four reminder fields (reminder_minutes, reminder_time, reminder_anchor, reminder_plan) leave the task as it is (`TaskSerializer.leaves_unchanged`) saves those reminders for that account only, with no new version, activity or notification, and answers 200 with the task; with a stale version it saves them first and then answers 409 with `current`; any other change from a reader, and a new task in their project, is refused with 403. Reviews B2, C and D all specify this package. Review C's warning stands: a tap without the sync change is worse than today, because the next sync turns the change into a duplicate task. Build all of it together.

Three traps in today's code (review B2's notes). `TaskDatabase.validateList` (App/lib/services/task_database.dart:313-329) refuses every local write in a viewer project (`updateTask` calls it at :501-513), so a save would end in «No se pudo actualizar el recordatorio». The sync's viewer branch (App/lib/repositories/cloud_task_repository.dart:149-171) turns any pending row there into a personal copy («… (offline copy)», task_database.dart:735-786, the English suffix hard-coded at :770) and sets the read-only notice («Este proyecto ahora es de solo lectura. Tu cambio pendiente se ha conservado como copia personal.», shown in red on Calendar, calendar_screen.dart:723-750, and in Cuenta). And a notification's «Completar» writes past both (App/lib/services/reminder_engine.dart:749-768).

UX-2032 (S1, decided), what a reader can do. On a task that rings for this account (`reminderRingsHere`, App/lib/widgets/reminder_control.dart:196: a «Todos» task, or one given to them) in a project where the account is «lector»: the task page's reminder line (App/lib/screens/task_detail_screen.dart:374-402, today `onChanged: !canEdit ? null : …`) becomes the tappable chip (outlined, button role, not «desactivado») and opens the usual reminder choices, with «Estos avisos son solo para ti.» (`reminderPlanJustYou`) fixed under the title, as on any shared task. A choice shows in the chip at once. Only the three fields the chip sets today change (`reminderMinutes`, `reminderTime`, `reminderPlan`; :383-389). Nothing else opens: the title, rows, chips, steps and files stay read-only, with no ✏, no 🗑, no bottom bar and no circle. Tasks that don't ring for the reader stay as they are («Recordatorio para Ana», or nothing on an unassigned task). The banner on such tasks changes from `viewOnlyTask` «Solo puedes ver esta tarea.» to a new string, for example `viewOnlyTaskReminders`: ES «Solo puedes ver esta tarea y elegir tus recordatorios.», EN “You can only view this task and choose your reminders.”, CA «Només pots veure aquesta tasca i triar els teus recordatoris.» (review B2's copy; reviews C and D said «no new copy», and the organizer took B2's, because «Solo puedes ver esta tarea.» alone contradicts a chip that opens). Other read-only tasks keep «Solo puedes ver esta tarea.».

How a choice is saved and synced (the contract above; how you build it is yours, say what you chose). Save it on the phone through a reminder-only write that skips `validateList`'s read-only refusal and nothing else (for example `TaskDatabase.updateOwnReminders(taskId, owner, minutes:, time:, plan:)`, and a `TaskNotifier` method that ends with `showLocal()`, never `await loadTasks()`), and mark the row pending. At sync, in a project where the account is «lector»: a pending row that differs from the server's copy only in the four reminder fields is sent with PUT, carrying the server's version and fields and the reader's reminders; 200 → acknowledged; 409 → take `current` as the task, keeping the reader's reminder values (the server saved them before answering). A pending row equal to the server's, reminders included (for example after Deshacer), is acknowledged, never copied. Neither ever makes a personal copy or sets the read-only notice. Any other pending change from a reader behaves as today. It must survive a restart, offline use (sent later), a sync, and a change the owner makes to the task meanwhile (the 409 path), with no copy and no notice.

UX-2403 (S3, review B2), with UX-2602 (S3, review D), merged: a reader's «Completar» on a reminder makes an «(offline copy)». Readers get their own reminders for «Todos» tasks and tasks given to them (DECISIONS 2026-10-23), and every task reminder carries «Completar» (App/lib/services/notification_service.dart:65-71). The tap marks the task done on the phone (reminder_engine.dart:749-798) and shows «Completada: …» with Deshacer; the next sync restores the shared task as not done, keeps «Sacar la basura (offline copy)» as a new personal task (which keeps repeating, for a repeating task), and shows the read-only notice to someone who was always a reader. Deshacer doesn't avoid it. In the app a reader's row has no circle (task_tile.dart:73, :275) and the task page no Completar (task_detail_screen.dart:463). Fix: (a) a reminder for a task in a project where this account is «lector» is posted without «Completar»: the single reminder keeps only «Posponer 10 min», and a plan notice has no button (tapping it opens the task, as now). Carry the role from `TaskDatabase.reminderTasks` (task_database.dart:377-425) into `PlannedReminder` (reminder_engine.dart:18) and choose the Android actions from it; on iOS use a category without «complete» (categories are registered at notification_service.dart:240 and :302: add a snooze-only one per language, and none for a reader's plan notice). (b) `ReminderEngine.action(id, 'complete')` refuses such a task: it returns false, writes nothing and leaves nothing pending, for notices already in the shade. (c) The «equal row is acknowledged» rule above also covers an old Deshacer. (d) The suffix of the copies still kept for editors' conflicts (assignment changed, task conflict; task_database.dart:770) is translated, for example `syncCopySuffix`: ES «(copia local)», EN “(offline copy)”, CA «(còpia local)» (review B2's words, matching `syncProblem`'s «copia local» / “offline copy”). The repository has no BuildContext: read the app's language as the reminder engine does (`readReminderCopy`, reminder_engine.dart:94-109), or pass the suffix in.

Voice commands keep treating a reader's tasks as view-only (Backend/docs/VOICE_COMMANDS.md:150: voice never changes reminders), so nothing changes in capture.

packages.title: Understanding and failing: Cancelar asks, the 8 s fallback stays quiet, the offline line says what to tap, banners show whole, and kept words are «conservadas»
brief: UX-2102 (S2, review A1): Cancelar during «Entendiendo…» parks the words without asking. App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart:1927-1930: `if (_phase == processing) { Navigator.pop(context); return; }`; Back and the swipe go through the same `_cancel()`; the 8 s slow state included. The sheet closes at once, the request keeps running, the answer is stored, and «Sin guardar · 1» appears above «Añadir tarea» with nothing to say why; for a free account the dictation counts. When listening, typing, or on a result with something to add, the same Cancelar asks «¿Conservar lo que has dicho para más tarde?». UX_REVIEW §6, U2's done-when: «No code path leaves words parked without the user choosing it.» Fix, for a first capture during understanding: ask the same `_askToKeep(spoken: …)` question. packages.title: After the tap: Deshacer restores without reopening the sheet, several added tasks name the day they landed on, and «Ha vuelto aquí» for one
brief: UX-2202 (S2, review A2): Deshacer after a voice deletion brings the red card back. App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart:3911-3923: Deshacer reopens the result (its result-saving twin is :3283-3295), and the reopened result announces its headline (:2779). So after «Tarea eliminada · Deshacer» the task comes back on its day while Calendar stays on today, under the scrim, and the sheet reopens on «Se eliminará: Ir a la peluquería (sáb, 31 de oct)» with the red filled «Eliminar» under the thumb (renders `commands/applied.delete-applied`, `applied.delete-undone`); with TalkBack the first thing heard is «Se eliminará: …». Every result with nothing to add does this: changes, completions and sets. On a task's own page the same Deshacer just restores (task_detail_screen.dart:84-89), and D1 (2026-10-18 night) already treats a result with nothing to add as disposable. Fix: (1) on a result that added nothing (changes, completions, deletions, sets), Deshacer restores and stops, with no sheet; a result that added tasks, alone or mixed with changes, keeps reopening, so a misheard task can still be fixed and added again. (2) One task deleted by voice is named, as a completion is («Completada: …», `notificationCompleted`), with a new string, for example `commandDeletedTitle`: ES «Eliminada: {title}», EN “Deleted: {title}”, CA «Suprimida: {title}» (:3767-3768); sets keep «3 tareas eliminadas» (`commandTasksDeleted`). The trade-off, accepted by review A2: re-picking a set's rows after an undo goes; saying it again does that. Update the UX-1707 checks in App/test/bulk_voice_commands_test.dart:3217-3290 from `reopensWithin` to «restored, no sheet».

UX-2203 (S2, review A2): after several tasks are added, nothing names the day you land on. The message (:3186-3206, :3721-3739): one task says «Añadida al vie, 30 de oct» (`taskAddedOn`) and a moved set «4 tareas movidas al jue, 29 de oct» (`commandTasksMovedTo`, UX-1703), but several added tasks say only «3 tareas añadidas», with «· también el …» for other days; at 1× the landing scroll (App/lib/screens/calendar_screen.dart:183-260, `_scrollToLit`) then pushes the day heading and the week strip off the top (`calendar/agenda.added.es.light.1x`), so no line on screen names the lit rows' day. The first-run example «Mañana, llamar al dentista y comprar pan» (UX-701) ends this way too. Fix: (1) when every dated task of the save lands on one day, name it as moves do, with a new string, for example `captureTasksAddedOn`: ES «{count, plural, =1{1 tarea añadida al {date}} other{{count} tareas añadidas al {date}}}», EN “{count, plural, =1{1 task added to {date}} other{{count} tasks added to {date}}}”, CA «{count, plural, =1{1 tasca afegida al {date}} other{{count} tasques afegides al {date}}}», {date} as `taskAddedOn` writes it. Saves spread over several days keep «· también …» (`captureAlsoOn`, `captureAlsoOnDays`), and an undated task in the mix keeps its existing part. (2) The landing keeps Calendar's day heading in view whenever it fits with the lit rows above the message, and lets it go only when they don't fit (`_scrollToLit`). P269 (before you) reordered the agenda, today's own rows first: tune the scroll on that layout.

packages.title: The result card: room around ✕ and «Activar recordatorios», «Tu nota», no second «Quitar», TalkBack hears what opens, a time question shows no guessed time
brief: UX-2205 (S2, review A2): a batch task's title touches its ✕. App/lib/widgets/capture_review_editor.dart:678-701: a collapsed row's title button (238 × 48 dp) runs right up to ✕ (48 × 48); AUDIT measures 0.0 dp on every card of the 7 `capture/result · several` renders, so a tap aimed at the end of a long title removes the task («Quitada · Deshacer»). Fix: remove «Quitar» from «Más opciones» (✕ and Cancelar remain; keep `reviewRemove` if ✕'s tooltip or anything else still uses it); on a task with no day the repeat row reads `repeatNeedsDate` («Añade una fecha para repetir» / “Add a date to repeat” / «Afegeix una data per repetir»), with no tap, as in the form.

UX-2211 (S1, review A2): TalkBack isn't told «Más opciones» or a batch card opened. The «Más opciones» ListTile (:825-847) and a collapsed row's title (:683-694) open content in place; TalkBack hears only «Más opciones, botón» and «Comprar pan y leche, botón», with no collapsed or expanded state and no hint that the title opens the task to edit (AUDIT `capture/result · one-task` and `· several`). Fix: wrap both in `Semantics(expanded: …)`, as the reminder sheet's expandable rows do since UX-1907; the title's tap hint is `editTask` («Editar tarea»).

UX-2212 (S1, review A2): an open time question's guess already shows as the time. `_dateLine` (:376-404) prints the day and the time, and :735-737: in `capture/result.question.es.light.1x` «jue, 5 de nov · 17:00» sits above «¿A las 5 de la mañana o de la tarde?», and TalkBack's arrival announcement reads both. The server sends no time when it asks (Backend/core/ai.py:341-344) and the phone's parser sends none (App/lib/services/local_capture.dart:131-140), so this shows when the model slips, and in the preview fixture (App/test/ux_previews/capture_previews.dart:556-559). Previews: re-render `capture/result.several` (es 1×, es 2×, ca 2×), `capture/result.question`, `notes/note-capture.result` (es 1×, es 2×) and `reminders/capture-card.plan-reminders-off`.

packages.title: «Sin fecha» means no day and no deadline, everywhere; a dated save from the Sin fecha page lands on Calendar
brief: UX-2308 (S2, review B1): «Sin fecha» counts tasks that have a deadline date. Calendar's count (App/lib/screens/calendar_screen.dart:654-658, `dueDate == null`), the Sin fecha page and Tareas' chip (App/lib/screens/home_screen.dart:151) use «no day», while the landing (voice_task_screen.dart:3230) and the row's «Sin fecha» (UX-1725, task_tile.dart:46-50) use «neither a day nor a deadline». So a deadline-only task, as in the owner's own example «terminar el diseño para el jueves a las 5», shows on its deadline's day and lands there (UX-902), and is also counted in «Sin fecha · N» on every day and listed on the Sin fecha page as «Vence jue, 29 de oct · 17:00» under the title «Sin fecha». Fix: «Sin fecha» (Calendar's count, the Sin fecha page and Tareas' chip) means neither a day nor a deadline, through one helper they share (for example `Task.undated` in App/lib/models/task.dart). The landing's rule is already right: leave App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart alone. Voice sets and searches are area A's and follow the server's contract: don't change them, but if the phone's matcher (App/lib/services/task_matcher.dart) picks «sin fecha» tasks with `dueDate == null`, say so in your notes. No copy change.

UX-2307 (S2, review B1): from Sin fecha, a task given a day lands unseen. `_land` (home_screen.dart:222-289): a page that isn't a root tab keeps its filter (:251), so the Sin fecha page (`HomeScreen(initialFilter: 3, isRoot: false)`, `/inbox`, reached from Calendar's «Sin fecha · N»; its `TaskActions(page: this)` :833-840) never lists a task that now has a date, and the landing waits forever (:714-720); Calendar behind it stays on today, and only the message names the day. The Día view already sends such saves back to Calendar (App/lib/screens/day_timeline_screen.dart:112-128). Fix: when a page can't list a just-saved task even after clearing its search, it lands on Calendar as the Día view does: pop to Calendar and set `CalendarFocus(day, ids, showCalendar: true)`, so Calendar shows the day with the row lit and «Añadida al …» with Deshacer (an undated task lights Calendar's «Sin fecha» row, as `CalendarFocus` already does). The same rule serves a project page whose dictation puts the task in another project (review B1's note for area C). No copy change.

Not yours: the agenda's order and its ticked rows (P269, before you, in calendar_screen.dart: keep them), the landing message's words (P274), the search fields' clear button (P288, after you, in home_screen.dart).
acceptance: A deadline-only task (deadline Thu 29 Oct at 17:00, no day): Calendar's «Sin fecha · N» doesn't count it; it isn't on `/inbox` or under Tareas' «Sin fecha» chip; it shows on Thu 29 Oct and in Tareas.
A task with neither a day nor a deadline is still counted and listed under «Sin fecha».

Toca para reintentar.» / “Couldn’t read your events. Tap to try again.” / «No s’han pogut llegir els esdeveniments. Toca per tornar-ho a provar.» (`calendarReadRetry`, unchanged). packages.title: The Día view fits the screen: one lane always fits, the header drops the current year, no stray dash, TalkBack skips the hour labels
brief: UX-2309 (S2, review B1): at 2×, Día view blocks run past the screen edge. App/lib/screens/day_timeline_screen.dart:387-391: each lane is at least `150 × scale` dp and the hour column `54 × scale`, inside a sideways scroll view (:396-401). At 2× on 360 dp a 108 dp hour column plus one 300 dp lane must fit in 328 dp, so about 76 dp of every block lies past the right edge, its title cut by the screen with no ellipsis («Paseo por el pa», «Llamar al médic»: `calendar/timeline.untimed.es.light.2x`). At 1× two items at once need two 150 dp lanes in 264 dp, so the second runs past the edge («Reunión con e»: `timeline.busy.es.light.1x`). Only a sideways drag shows the rest, and nothing says so. Fix: one lane always fits the space beside the hours; side-by-side lanes share it, and scroll sideways only below a readable width (say which width you chose), with the scrollbar always shown, as «Sin hora»'s is. Size the hour column to its widest label. Titles end with an ellipsis inside their block; the block's TalkBack label and tooltip keep the whole title.

UX-2314 (S1, review B1): the year, a stray dash, every hour aloud. The header (:227, `fullDate`, App/lib/l10n/region.dart:17-18) reads «miércoles, 28 de octubre de 2026»: 2 lines at 1×, 3 at 2× (`timeline.normal.es.light.1x`, `timeline.untimed.es.light.2x`), while Calendar drops the current year (calendar_screen.dart:771-779: «The current year goes without saying»). An item with no duration gets a 5 × 2 dp teal dash poking out of its block's rounded corner (:527-535). TalkBack stops on all 25 hour labels between the items (:403-426): 42 stops for 11 items on the busy day (AUDIT `calendar/timeline · busy`), though each item already says its time («Paseo por el parque, 08:30»). Fix: the header follows Calendar's heading rule, with no year when it's the current one (ES «miércoles, 28 de octubre»): put the rule in a helper in App/lib/l10n/region.dart and use it here; don't change calendar_screen.dart, whose heading must read exactly as before. An item with no duration gets no bar; one with a duration has its bar clipped to the block's shape. The hour column is excluded from semantics.
Previews: re-render `calendar/timeline.normal`, `timeline.untimed` and `timeline.busy` (es 1×, es 2×, ca 2×).
Not yours: the event error line (P277, before you) and the deadline blocks' colour (P279, after you), both in this file.
acceptance: `calendar/timeline.normal` and `timeline.untimed` at ES 2× and CA 2× on 360×800: every block ends inside the screen, and a title that doesn't fit ends with an ellipsis inside its block; the block's semantics label carries the whole title.
`calendar/timeline.busy` at ES 1× on 360×800: both lanes are inside the screen, or a scrollbar shows without touching.
For a day of the current year the header reads «miércoles, 28 de octubre», on one line at ES 1× on 360×800; for another year it keeps the year; Calendar's heading is unchanged.
An item without a duration has no bar, and no teal dash pokes out of a block's corner.
AUDIT for `calendar/timeline · busy`: 17 TalkBack stops, none of them an hour label.

packages.title: Task rows read whole and calm: titles wrap, no stray swipe actions for TalkBack, passed deadlines and «Necesita responsable» in grey, priority and counts in plain words
brief: UX-2305 (S2, review B1): at large text, task titles stop after two lines. App/lib/widgets/task_tile.dart:297-300 (`maxLines: 2`, ellipsis) on every row (Calendar, Tareas, Sin fecha, project pages, Completadas, the Día view's «Sin hora»): at 2× on 360 dp «Llamar al médico para p…» and «Recoger a los niños del co…» (AUDIT: “ellipsis at 2 lines” on `calendar/agenda.normal`, `.completed` and `.added`, ES and CA), about 23 characters; on the emulator at 2.0 on 360 dp the 17-character «Reunión con Laura» already fills both lines; at 1× titles past about 55 characters stop too; the whole title is only on the task's page. Fix: titles wrap in full (no `maxLines`); the notes line stays at one line. No copy change.

UX-1416 (S2; in the ledger since 2026-10-19 as device-check, reopened by review B1): rows still expose two unnamed scroll actions. The `Dismissible` on every editable row (task_tile.dart:227-251) keeps its swipe's two semantic actions next to P178's named «Cambiar fecha»: AUDIT lists every Calendar and Tareas row as “→ tap, scroll left, scroll right, «Cambiar fecha»”, and the emulator tree marks each row `scrollable="true"` (`device/a11y/screen-calendar.today.es.light.1.0.xml`, «Comprar fruta»). Scroll right completes the task, scroll left opens «Cambiar fecha», and TalkBack may also send its scroll to a scrollable row while moving through a long agenda (a phone check). Fix: while `MediaQuery.accessibleNavigationOf(context)` is on (TalkBack, Switch Access), the row's `Dismissible` has `direction: DismissDirection.none`; the row keeps «Cambiar fecha» as its custom action, and its circle completes. No copy change.

UX-2313 (S1, review B1): a passed deadline says it twice, in alarm red. task_tile.dart:104-110 and :143-150 build «Vence lun, 26 de oct · Fecha límite vencida» (`deadlineLabel` · `deadlineOverdue`; EN “Due Mon, 26 Oct · Deadline passed”; CA «Termini: dl., 26 d’oct. · Termini vençut») in `colors.error`, under the calm grey «Atrasada» heading; the task's page builds the same pair (App/lib/screens/task_detail_screen.dart:319), and the Día view draws every deadline red, passed or not (App/lib/screens/day_timeline_screen.dart:472-476). Fix: one phrase in the row's usual grey, a new string, for example `deadlinePassedOn`: ES «Venció el {date}», EN “Was due {date}”, CA «Termini vençut: {date}», {date} as `deadlineLabel` gets it (the weekday date, and the time when the deadline has one), so ES «Venció el lun, 26 de oct»; the Catalan is review B1's and wants a native read. It replaces the pair wherever it's built: the row and the task's page (P280 reworks that page's date rows after you, and keeps this phrase). The Día view's deadline blocks use the theme's tertiary colour, passed or not; their «Fecha límite:» prefix says what they are. Remove `deadlineOverdue` from the three catalogs once nothing uses it.

UX-2312 (S1, review B1), with UX-2512 (S1, review C), merged: row and count copy slips. (a) `priorityValue` (ES «Prioridad {priority}», app_es.arb:324; CA «Prioritat {priority}», app_ca.arb:303) takes the standalone names («Alta», «Media»; CA «Mitjana»), so rows read «Prioridad Alta» just under Tareas' «Prioridad alta» chip (`tasks/tasks-tab.normal`, `tasks/project.shared.ca.light.2x`), and TalkBack reads it so (noted in run 2026-10-19-app and never filed). Fix: an ICU select on the level, not the standalone name: ES «Prioridad alta» / «Prioridad media» / «Prioridad baja»; CA «Prioritat alta» / «Prioritat mitjana» / «Prioritat baixa»; EN “High priority” / “Medium priority” / “Low priority” (as today). It's drawn on rows (task_tile.dart:132-134), the capture card (App/lib/widgets/capture_review_editor.dart:629, :804) and the form (App/lib/widgets/task_editor.dart:948): change those call sites, for example through a `context.priorityPhrase(int)` beside `priorityName` (App/lib/l10n/region.dart:49). The standalone «Alta» on the task's page and on command cards stays. (b) `agendaCounts` (app_es.arb:314, app_ca.arb:293, app_en.arb:540; calendar_screen.dart:906): at 2× it splits «4 pendientes · 1 / completada», the number from its word (`agenda.normal.es.light.2x`, `agenda.added.es.light.2x`), and when the day is done it reads «0 pendientes · 1 completada» (`App/build/calendar-feedback-light.png`), a zero shown as content. Fix: a no-break space (U+00A0) between each number and its words, and inside «per fer» and “to do” («4 pendientes», «1 completada», CA «4 per fer»); with nothing left, only the done half: ES «1 completada» / «5 completadas», EN “1 completed” / “5 completed”, CA «1 completada» / «5 completades». ICU only: calendar_screen.dart needs no change. (c) `completedTaskSummary`, ES (app_es.arb:992; completed_tasks_screen.dart:103): «…Pulsa su casilla para reabrirla.» / «…Pulsa una casilla para reabrir una.» become «…Toca su casilla para reabrirla.» / «…Toca una casilla para reabrir una.» (the app's other instructions say «Toca»).

UX-2616 (S1; filed by the organizer from review C's cross-slice note to area B): «Necesita responsable» («Cal un responsable») is drawn in the error red (task_tile.dart:170, `textColor: unassigned ? colors.error : null`; render `tasks/project.many-people.ca.light.2x`): an alarm colour for a neutral state, against the calm styling the loop uses for overdue items (TA-9, as for passed deadlines above). Fix: the row's usual colour. No copy change.

Previews: re-render `calendar/agenda.normal`, `.completed` and `.added` (ES and CA, 1× and 2×), `tasks/tasks-tab.normal`, `tasks/project.shared` (CA 2×) and `tasks/project.many-people`; add a row with a passed deadline, `tasks/tasks-tab.deadline-passed` (ES and CA, 1× and 2×). Tests that look for `deadlineOverdue`, two-line titles, «Prioridad Alta» or the old agendaCounts output rightly break: update them and say which.

Not yours: the agenda's order and WD34's line (P269), the Día view's lanes and header (P278), the result card's spacing and fields (P275), all before you; the task page's date rows, notes and Completar (P280), and the form's repeat sheet, chips and lifecycle (P281), which keep to their own lines.
acceptance: `calendar/agenda.normal` in ES and CA at 2× on 360×800 shows «Llamar al médico para pedir cita» whole; AUDIT lists no cut row title on `agenda.normal`, `agenda.completed`, `agenda.added` or `tasks/tasks-tab.normal`; a row's notes line is still one line.

Semantics test with accessible navigation on: Calendar and Tareas rows have no scroll-left or scroll-right action, keep the «Cambiar fecha» custom action, and the circle still completes. With accessible navigation off, a swipe right still completes and a swipe left still opens «Cambiar fecha».

A row with a passed deadline (Mon 26 Oct), ES and CA at 1× and 2×: it reads «Venció el lun, 26 de oct» / «Termini vençut: dl., 26 d’oct.» once, in the row's usual grey (AUDIT finds no error-coloured text on it); the task's page shows the same phrase.
Día view: deadline blocks use the theme's tertiary colour, passed or not.

Rows read «Prioridad alta» / «Prioridad media» (CA «Prioritat alta» / «Prioritat mitjana»; EN “High priority”) on Calendar, Tareas, the capture card and the form, and TalkBack reads the same; the task page's standalone «Alta» is unchanged.

`calendar/agenda.normal` at ES and CA 2× keeps «1 completada» on one line; a day with nothing left reads «1 completada» (EN “1 completed”, CA «1 completada»), and with five «5 completadas» / “5 completed” / «5 completades».
Completadas in Spanish reads «1 tarea completada. Toca su casilla para reabrirla.» and «3 tareas completadas. Toca una casilla para reabrir una.».
«Necesita responsable» on a project's row (`tasks/project.many-people`, CA 2×) is drawn in the row's usual colour, not the error colour.
Catalog: no `deadlineOverdue` key remains if nothing uses it.
deviceChecks: Phone with TalkBack: move through a long agenda past the screen's end; nothing gets completed or moved, and a row's actions menu offers «Cambiar fecha».

packages.title: A task's page: Completar returns to the list, the date reads once, notes and labels read as what they are
brief: UX-2404 (S2, review B2): Completar keeps the task open, its main button now «Reabrir». App/lib/screens/task_detail_screen.dart:489-502 (the bottom bar), :203-204 (the «TAREA COMPLETADA» label), :108-118 (which occurrence it shows): Completar ticks the task and shows «Tarea completada · Deshacer», but the page stays; a small grey «TAREA COMPLETADA» appears above the title and the filled button under the finger becomes «Reabrir», so a hesitant second tap reopens the task, and two undos are offered at once. Opened without an occurrence (Activity, App/lib/screens/activity_screen.dart:157; «Tareas con archivos», App/lib/screens/tasks_with_files_screen.dart:98), a repeating task's page re-picks the next open occurrence after the tick, so the date jumps to tomorrow while the button still says «Completar», and the «it didn't work» second tap completes tomorrow's too. Fix: Completar on a task's page closes it, as Back does, and leaves the existing «Tarea completada · Deshacer» over the list, where the row shows ticked; Deshacer reopens it. «Reabrir» on a task that was already completed when opened keeps the page. While open, the page keeps the occurrence it opened with: pin its key at the first build. No new copy. The message stays «Tarea completada» (WD34's line is for Calendar's rows only, P269).

UX-2409 (S1, review B2), with UX-2507 (S2, review C), merged: TalkBack reads a task's notes as an unnamed text field. AUDIT `tasks/detail · full` #13 and `notes-steps` #11 read «text field (no label) value "…" [read-only] → long press»: without `onTap` the notes are an unnamed `SelectableText` (App/lib/widgets/note_text.dart:37-41; task_detail_screen.dart:364-369 and :575-609, where `_body` names the text only for a note that opens the editor, UX-1521). The same holds for every note in a project the account only views (UX-1521's leftover). Fix: when the text has no tap, read-only notes are one node: wrap the surface in `Semantics(container: true, label: …, value: <the text>)`, with the label `notes` («Notas») for a task and `noteBody` («Tu nota») for a note, and exclude the SelectableText's own node, as the editable case does, without `button` or `onTap`. Links stay their own buttons; long-press selection stays.

UX-2410 (S1, review B2): date and time take two rows; «Sin hora» and the year add words. :281-331: two rows, both opening Cambiar fecha: the date with its year (3 lines at 2× in Catalan, `tasks/detail.alert-passed.ca.light.2x`), and «Hora · Sin hora» even with no time; a deadline-only task adds «Planificado para · Sin fecha» and «Hora · Sin hora» above «Vence … / Antes de que termine el día». Fix: one row, «Planificado para» over «jueves, 29 de octubre · 12:00»: the time only when set, the year only when it isn't this year (P278's helper in App/lib/l10n/region.dart gives a date without the current year: use it if it fits, without changing it). No row for «Sin hora». No «Sin fecha» row on a deadline-only task (Cambiar fecha in the bottom bar still adds a day). The deadline row drops «Antes de que termine el día» (`deadlineEndDay`; remove it from the catalogs if nothing else uses it). P279 (before you) put «Venció el …» in that row for a passed deadline: keep it.

UX-2416 (S1, review B2): labels look like chips but do nothing (:264-271: outlined Material chips, «#casa», the look of the page's tappable chips, with no tap). Fix: one line of text, «#casa · #recados», in `onSurfaceVariant`, with no outline and no tap.
Previews: re-render `tasks/detail.*` (ES and CA, 1× and 2×) and add `tasks/detail.labels` (es 1×).

Not yours: the reader's chip and banner (P271) and the reminder chip's words (P270), both before you; the note's project chip and delete words (P294, after you); the passed-deadline phrase itself (P279).
acceptance: Calendar row → task page → Completar: Calendar shows again, the row ticked, with «Tarea completada · Deshacer»; Deshacer reopens it.
Opening an already-completed task and tapping «Reabrir» keeps the page, which now offers «Completar».
Activity → a daily repeating task → Completar: the page closes; tomorrow's occurrence is never shown on it, nor completed.

AUDIT `tasks/detail · notes-steps` (ES 1×) and `detail · full`: «Notas» with the notes as its value, and no unlabeled text field; a reader's note reads «Tu nota» with its text as value; a link in the notes is its own button; a long press still selects text.

Task page, ES and CA at 1× and 2× on 360×800: a timed task on Thu 29 Oct 2026 at 12:00 shows one row, «Planificado para» over «jueves, 29 de octubre · 12:00», and no «Hora» row; an untimed one shows «jueves, 29 de octubre» and no «Sin hora»; a deadline-only task shows no «Planificado para · Sin fecha» row and no «Antes de que termine el día»; a task in 2027 shows its year.
Labels show as one line, «#casa · #recados», with no outline and no tappable node.

packages.title: The task form keeps edits if Android closes the app, repeats in one tap, and asks less
brief: UX-2406 (S2, review B2): edits to a saved task are lost if Android closes the app. App/lib/widgets/task_editor.dart:299-307 keeps a new task's words from the first letter (UX-1005) only while `_creating`; a saved task being edited lives only in the form's memory, and there is no app-lifecycle handling (`_back`, :486-494). If Android closes the app in the background (a call, the camera, low memory: common on cheaper phones), the edits are gone and the app reopens on Calendar. Fix: when the app goes to the background (`AppLifecycleState.paused`) with a changed, valid edit form, save the changes as Back does (D12), without closing the form or showing a message. The later Guardar cambios or Back shows «Cambios guardados · Deshacer» as today, and its Deshacer restores the task as it was when the form opened, not as it was at the background save. An untouched form, or one whose title was emptied, saves nothing.

UX-2407 (S2, review B2): the repeat sheet hides its choices in a dropdown. App/lib/widgets/repeat_rule_control.dart:127-142: the sheet's only choice is «No se repite ▾», two taps to see and pick «Cada día», then Listo, then the form's own button; the interval dialog's filled «Guardar cambios» (:64-70, `keepChanges`) only sets a number in the sheet, so there are three confirmations, two with the same words (EN “Keep changes”, CA «Conserva els canvis»). The sheet opens from task_editor.dart:1314-1333 and from the capture card. Fix: replace the dropdown with five one-tap rows (No se repite, Cada día, Cada semana, Cada mes, Cada año: the dropdown's existing strings), the chosen one ticked (✓), as the reminder sheet's rows are; the weekday chips and the end date stay under them, and Listo applies. The interval dialog's button becomes `done` («Listo» / “Done” / «Fet»).

UX-2413 (S1, review B2): day chips sit 4 dp apart at large text, and weekday chips touch. task_editor.dart:1229-1231 (Hoy / Mañana / Elegir día, `runSpacing: 4`; AUDIT `form/new-task · filled` at 1.3×, 2× and ca 2×: «Hoy» and «Mañana» are 4 dp above «Elegir día», and «Mañana» applies at once while «Elegir día» opens a sheet), App/lib/widgets/schedule_editor.dart:262-264 (`runSpacing: 4`), repeat_rule_control.dart:76 (no `runSpacing`). Fix: `runSpacing: 8` in the three Wraps, and `spacing: 8` for the weekday chips.

UX-2414 (S1, review B2): in the edit form, the keyboard's ✓ saves and closes the form (task_editor.dart:810-815); in the new form the same key only closes the keyboard. Fix: the edit form's title key closes the keyboard, as in the new form; saving stays on Guardar cambios and Back.

UX-2419 (S1, review B2): the attach sheet explains phone-only files to every saved task. :684-696 shows `fileUploadHelp` (31 words about «older local files» and «Subir en los detalles de la tarea») on every saved task's «Añadir adjunto»; since sign-in is required almost no task has such a file, and the 6 MB limit is said when a file is too big (`fileLimit`). UX-1006 removed it from new tasks only. Fix: show the paragraph only when this task still has a file kept only on the phone (one that shows «Subir»); otherwise the sheet is its two rows.

Previews (App/test/ux_previews/form_previews.dart): add the repeat sheet, `form/repeat-sheet.open` (es 2×, ca 2×); re-render `form/new-task.filled` (es 1.3×, es 2×, ca 2×) and `form/edit-task.existing`.
Not yours: the priority phrase at task_editor.dart:948 (P279, which may run before you: keep it), the reminder row (P270).
acceptance: Edit form of a saved task, ES 1×: change the title, then send `AppLifecycleState.paused`: the task is updated in the repository; then `resumed`: the form is still open with the new title; Back → «Cambios guardados · Deshacer»; Deshacer restores the title it had when the form opened.
An untouched edit form, or one with an emptied title, saves nothing on pause.
Más detalles → Repetir → «Cada día» → Listo sets a daily repeat in 3 taps after Más detalles (from 4): the five rows show, the chosen one with ✓, and the weekday chips and the end date still work.
The interval dialog's button reads «Listo» / “Done” / «Fet».
AUDIT for `form/new-task · filled` (ES 1.3×, ES 2×, CA 2×) and the repeat sheet: no gap under 8 dp between the day chips, or between the weekday chips.
Edit form: the keyboard's action on the title leaves the form open with the keyboard down; the new form behaves as before.
«Añadir adjunto» on a saved task with no phone-only file shows its two rows and no paragraph; on a task with a file that shows «Subir», the paragraph shows.
`form/repeat-sheet.open` renders at ES 2× and CA 2× with every row whole.

packages.title: «A tu manera» says where its words go, the first time; the reminder sheet keeps its title on every task
brief: UX-2405 (S2, review B2), with UX-2604 (S2, review D), merged: «A tu manera» never says its words go to Google's AI. Typed or dictated rhythms in «A tu manera» (Pro; App/lib/widgets/reminder_plan_sheet.dart:646-737, the `ai/reminder-plan/` request at :286-316) go to the server's AI, and the sheet says nothing about it: its only helper is the example (:667-673). Ajustes › Voz's note (`capturePrivacy`: app_es.arb:307, app_en.arb:527, app_ca.arb:286; voice_settings_screen.dart:196-205) covers only adding, finding and changing tasks, while the website's privacy policy now says reminder words go there too (website review 2026-10-28-site). Fix (the organizer settled reviews B2 and D: B2's «first time» rule, D's place, and the line's words from P266 as review A1 asked): (a) the first time «A tu manera» is opened on this phone, show `capturePrivacyLine` under its field (:667). P266 (before you) changed it to «Tus palabras van a la IA de Google. Más en Otros ajustes › Voz.» / “Your words go to Google’s AI. More in Other settings › Voice.” / «Les paraules van a la IA de Google. Més a Altres opcions › Veu.». It stays while that sheet is open and doesn't show on later openings; remember it in `RegionalPreferences` (App/lib/providers/regional_provider.dart) with its own flag, as `privacyShown` does for the capture sheet (for example `reminderPrivacyShown`). A free account sees the Pro badge, not the field, and no line. Widen @capturePrivacyLine's description to name both places. (b) Widen `capturePrivacy`'s second sentence only (review B2's words): ES «Para añadir, buscar o cambiar tareas, o pedir recordatorios a tu manera, tus palabras van por internet a la IA de Google.», EN “To add, find or change tasks, or to ask for reminders your way, your words go over the internet to Google’s AI.”, CA «Per afegir, cercar o canviar tasques, o demanar recordatoris a la teva manera, les teves paraules van per internet a la IA de Google.» The other sentences stay as they are.

UX-2412 (S1, review B2): at 2×, a personal task's reminder sheet starts with «Elegir hora del aviso». :743-770: the title scrolls away unless the task is shared, and :176-190 opens the sheet scrolled to the plan, so in `reminders/sheet.strength.es.light.2x` the first visible line is the tappable row «Elegir hora del aviso», which reads as the sheet's heading, with «Recordatorio» and the ticked row above the edge. Fix: keep «Recordatorio» fixed above the choices on every task, with the same 1 dp edge (`reminder-sheet-header-edge`, UX-2035); only the «solo para ti» line stays shared-only.

Tests that read the old `capturePrivacy` or `capturePrivacyLine` (App/test/voice_privacy_copy_test.dart, App/test/voice_settings_test.dart) rightly break: update them. Not yours: the capture sheet's use of the line (P266), the reminder chip's words (P270), the reader's tap (P271), the Pro screen (P290).
acceptance: Reminder sheet on a Pro account, «A tu manera» opened for the first time on this phone, ES 1× and 2× and CA 2× on 360×800: «Tus palabras van a la IA de Google. Más en Otros ajustes › Voz.» / «Les paraules van a la IA de Google. Més a Altres opcions › Veu.» shows under its field, whole, and «Listo» stays in view.
Closing the sheet and opening «A tu manera» again, on the same task or another: no line.
A free account's «A tu manera» (with the Pro badge) shows no line.

Ajustes › Otros ajustes › Voz shows «…Para añadir, buscar o cambiar tareas, o pedir recordatorios a tu manera, tus palabras van por internet a la IA de Google. …» (EN “…To add, find or change tasks, or to ask for reminders your way, your words go over the internet to Google’s AI. …”; CA «…Per afegir, cercar o canviar tasques, o demanar recordatoris a la teva manera, les teves paraules van per internet a la IA de Google. …»), the other sentences unchanged.

`reminders/sheet.strength` at ES 2× and CA 2× on a personal task: «Recordatorio» is the first line, fixed, with the 1 dp edge under it, when the sheet opens scrolled to the plan; no «solo para ti» line on a personal task.

packages.title: Notas adds only where it can, and puts a note where it says; its filter says «Todos los proyectos»
brief: UX-2501 (S2, review C): a note added in Notas can go where the list doesn't show it. App/lib/screens/notes_screen.dart:256-269: «Añadir nota» always shows; :47-48: `_saveTo` is null when the account can't add to the project shown; :71-95: a note the list doesn't show leaves the list as it is. packages.title: Sharing and group pages answer where you tapped: rows change at once, progress shows in view, errors come as a message, nothing typed is lost; plain sharing copy; whole addresses; buttons apart
brief: UX-2502 (S2, review C): on the sharing and group pages, a change waits for a full sync and reports at the top. App/lib/screens/list_sharing_screen.dart:88-130 (`_applied`, the wait at :108-111): a role change, a removal or a revoked invitation shows only after a full `loadTasks()` sync; :396-401: the error banner and the progress bar sit under the headline; :355-359: `skipLoadingOnRefresh: false` blanks the page to a spinner on every reload. App/lib/screens/groups_screen.dart:412-461: rename, archive, restore, role, revoke, spoken name and transfer wait the same way; :652-661: banner and bar at the top, adding about 24 dp above the content while busy; :363-378 (`_guard`) reloads on error, and with Riverpod 2.5.1's `.when` (`skipError: false`) a failed reload offline swaps the whole page for `LoadFailed` («No se ha podido cargar. Revisa la conexión.» + Reintentar, :196-209), so the action's own message never shows; :787-806 (rename) and :593-605 (spoken name) close the dialog before sending, so a failure drops the typed name (create and invite keep it through `submit:`, UX-328). At 2× the bottom actions are 2–3 screens below the bar (`sharing/group.owner.es.light.2x`, `sharing/project-sharing.owner.es.light.2x`). Proyectos and Novedades already report their action failures as the floating message (task_lists_screen.dart:90-96, :132-133; activity_screen.dart:72-77). Fix, with no new copy: (1) after role, remove, resend, revoke, rename, archive, restore, spoken name and transfer, refresh the page's own data as soon as the server answers, and run `loadTasks()` behind (`unawaited`), as the invite already does (list_sharing_screen.dart:108-113); leave and delete keep waiting, since they close the page. (2) Keep the page on screen while it reloads: the sharing page uses `skipLoadingOnRefresh: true`; the group page doesn't swap itself for `LoadFailed` when a reload after a failed action fails (keep the data, or don't reload on error). (3) Show progress as a 2 dp bar under the app bar, in view at any scroll, with nothing shifting; an action's failure goes through `showFeedback(requestProblemText(…))`, as on Proyectos; the top banner stays only for a page that couldn't load. (4) Rename and the spoken name pass `submit:`, so a failure stays inside the dialog with the typed name and the error, as `_create` and `_invite` do.

UX-2511 (S1, review C): sharing copy uses sync jargon, «Mis asignaciones», and a sentence about tasks. New values (review C's; the Catalan wants a native read): the second sentence of `removeAccessHelp` (app_es.arb:535, app_en.arb:1121, app_ca.arb:514; the «Retirar acceso» confirmation): ES «Los cambios que aún no haya enviado se perderán.», EN “Changes they haven’t sent yet will be lost.”, CA «Els canvis que encara no hagi enviat es perdran.» (the first sentence unchanged). `sharingRemovalHelp` (:540; in «Cómo funciona el acceso compartido», `sharing/project-sharing.how-it-works`): ES «Al salir o perder el acceso, el proyecto desaparece de este teléfono la próxima vez que se conecte. Las copias que hayas exportado se quedan.», EN “When you leave or lose access, the project leaves this phone the next time it connects. Copies you exported stay.”, CA «Quan surts del projecte o en perds l’accés, el projecte desapareix d’aquest telèfon el pròxim cop que es connecti. Les còpies que hagis exportat es queden.». `sharingRolesHelp` (:525): its last clause becomes ES «Las tareas compartidas se quedan en este proyecto.», EN “Shared tasks stay in this project.”, CA «Les tasques compartides es queden en aquest projecte.» (the export clause goes). `updatesAssigned` «Mis asignaciones» (:1173; the value under «Novedades del proyecto», list_sharing_screen.dart:336-340, project_preferences.dart:26-30; the rest of the app says «Para mí»): ES «Solo lo que es para mí», EN “Only what’s for me”, CA «Només el que és per a mi». And the network error on the sharing, group and invitation screens ends at «…inténtalo de nuevo.»: `requestProblemText` (App/lib/l10n/request_locale.dart:49-50) adds «Tus tareas siguen guardadas en este teléfono.» to network errors unless `onSignIn: true` (the name sheet passes it, UX-1229). Give it a parameter that drops only that sentence (for example `bool keptNote = true`), leaving `onSignIn`'s rate-limit meaning alone, and pass it from list_sharing_screen.dart (:188, :365, :398), groups_screen.dart (:144, :656), invitation_review_screen.dart (:181) and invitation_cards.dart (:155, :229).

UX-2513 (S1, review C): emails break mid-word on the members and group pages: a member's email (list_sharing_screen.dart:282-285), a pending invitation (:443), groups_screen.dart:711, and «Sesión iniciada como …» (App/lib/screens/invitation_review_screen.dart:171). packages.title: Novedades has its own icon and says when a task moved; TalkBack hears «Actividad» as one stop
brief: UX-2506 (S2, review C): the header's people icon opens «Novedades», not people. App/lib/screens/activity_screen.dart:43: `Icons.groups_outlined`, with the tooltip «Novedades»; the same icon means «Grupos» (task_lists_screen.dart:277; groups_screen.dart:316), shared projects in the «Todos los proyectos» sheet (project_scope_control.dart:432) and «Todos» as the person a task is for (task_assignment_picker.dart:99, :152; task_tile.dart:167). UX-2508 (S2, review C): «Ana ha actualizado: …» never says what changed. Novedades' `activityEntry` (activity_screen.dart:213-225; ES «{actor} ha actualizado: {title}», app_es.arb:1190) and a task's own «Actividad» (:344-352, `activityUpdated` «Ha actualizado una tarea», :1180) read the same for a moved task as for any edit, and in a family project the commonest entry is a moved task. packages.title: Every search clears in one tap
brief: UX-2509 (S2, review C): searches can only be cleared letter by letter. decisions.question: Should «Guardar como tarea» show its one task, for a tap, before saving? (UX-2612, S2, filed by the organizer from review A1's question D-A1-1.) Today it saves the phone's own reading at once, unseen, after the 8 s wait, after a failure, and on «No se encontraron tareas»; UX_REVIEW §3.5 says «instantly», and D3 approved that section. That reading is always one task, so «Mañana, llamar al dentista y comprar pan» becomes one task with both things in its title. Every other result keeps a confirming tap (UX-615 kept it until the §7 test). P273 already makes the button a quiet text button while the assistant still works (UX-2103), so it's pressed less by mistake. Options: (a) show it as a normal result card with «Añadir al calendario»: one more tap, on a fallback path, and the person sees the day it read and that it's one task; (b) keep it instant, for speed.
decisions.recommendation: (a), as review A1 recommends: it's the app's least reliable reading, and seeing it costs one tap on a path that's rare. One small package after this run (the card already exists); reversible.

decisions.question: Should the app keep the time each task is completed, so Completadas lists the most recently done first? (UX-2311, S2, review B1.) Completadas follows the planned date, with undated tasks last (App/lib/widgets/task_list.dart:39-46): «Comprar pan» ticked by mistake this morning sits after months of dated history, and a task due next month and done today sits at the top. Neither the app nor the server keeps a completion time (the server has only `updated_at`), so ordering by when each task, or each repeat, was done means saving that time with every tick, on the phone and on the server: new stored data, so it's yours. P269 already keeps a reopened row in place until the page is left. Options: (a) yes: save the time of each completion, phone and server, and list Completadas by it, newest first; completions from before keep today's order after the timed ones; (b) no: keep the planned-date order.
decisions.recommendation: (a). The page's job is getting back what was just ticked, and a completion time is the smallest change that does it; nothing shows the time, only the order uses it. Server first (the main session), then one small app package.
